# SnapShots

> WordPress plugin for named development snapshots of the database and uploads.

SnapShots saves and restores site state on the same server via the admin bar or `wp snapshot` WP-CLI commands. It is for local and development sites, not off-site production backup.

## Docs

- Landing page: https://snapshots.everpress.co/
- Agent guide (WP-CLI workflow): https://snapshots.everpress.co/agents.md
- Source repository: https://github.com/everpress-co/snapshots
- WordPress.org plugin: https://wordpress.org/plugins/snapshots/

## Agent quick reference

When SnapShots is installed on a dev site:

1. `wp snapshot list --format=json`
2. `wp snapshot backup "Before <task>" --files` before risky changes
3. `wp snapshot restore <slug>` only for your task snapshot or when the user asks. Use the slug or `file` id from `list`, not the display name.
4. Do not `wp snapshot delete` unless the user asks

See agents.md for restore side effects and requirements.
